# Aurora Coworking Ljubljana

> Member-run coworking space at Železna cesta 14 (level 1), 1000 Ljubljana, Slovenia, a short walk from the train and bus station. Part of Aurora Coworking. Two memberships: Flex (120€ + VAT a month, any free desk) and Fixed (180€ + VAT a month, your own desk), both with 24/7 access, two call booths (Zürich, Wrocław), two meeting rooms (Bohinj up to 10 people, Otočec), free coffee and a kitchen with fridge. First visit is free, coffee included.

- [Home](https://lj.auroracoworking.com/index.md): the space, prices, members and what they build, location, first-visit booking, FAQ.

- [Hot desk / Flex desk](https://lj.auroracoworking.com/hot-desk-ljubljana/index.md): the Flex membership.
- [Meeting rooms & call booths](https://lj.auroracoworking.com/meeting-room-ljubljana/index.md): Bohinj, Otočec, Zürich, Wrocław.
- [Digital nomads](https://lj.auroracoworking.com/digital-nomads-ljubljana/index.md): working remotely from Ljubljana.
- [Slovenščina](https://lj.auroracoworking.com/sl/index.md): the same in Slovenian.
